verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a public Management API (trigger.dev/docs/management/overview) with SDK examples for listing/triggering/canceling runs, and a runtime probe confirms the live REST API at api.trigger.dev is properly auth-gated (401 with RFC-7807 body) rather than a dead stub. This is corroborated by an official CLI and MCP server that wrap the same API, showing real agentic drivability. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger schema (probe found all candidate paths 404), independent third-party confirmation of API robustness beyond the vendor probe.
